card.name: Start of 'reduce' and 'reductase' words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word that continues as 'reduce', 'reducing' or 'reductase', where 'red' is split off from the rest. It appears in capitalised headings, hyphenated 'acid-reducing', and 'HMG-CoA Reductase'.

modes.label: Capitalised REDUCE
modes.description: The 'RED' start of REDUCE in all-caps instructions or table headings.
modes.example: DELAY next dose of YONDELIS for up to 3 weeks<< RED>>UCE next dose of YONDELIS

modes.label: Acid-reducing agents
modes.description: The 're' after a hyphen in 'gastric acid-reducing agents'.
modes.example: Avoid concomitant use of gastric acid<<-re>>ducing agents.

modes.label: HMG-CoA Reductase
modes.description: The 'Red' start of 'Reductase' in statin drug-interaction headings.

card.writes: It promotes 'red' spellings and suppresses 'decrease' words, so it favors completing a split 'red' word, not a separate decrease word.
card.plain: It fires when the word 'reduce' or 'reductase' has just begun, at its first few letters.
